quote: We prompt GPT-4o to give direct comments on each error committed and to generate the corrected utterance.
We also present users with a revised version of their utterance with their mistakes corrected …
ACE uses the annotation categories to identify users' mistakes and then provides targeted feedback based on the error definitions, along with in-context examples of feedback written by experts.
datasets: annotated dataset of spoken negotiation transcripts
outputs: feedback messages, revised utterances, turn‑based feedback

quote: We recruited a group of 374 users who participated in two trials of negotiation.
We relied on small scale expert evaluations of outputs to choose the best models …
For each model we tested (GPT-4, GPT-4o, and GPT-3.5) we generated 10-15 examples of output and presented them to two experts who then selected which output they preferred.
guideline: Participants answered questions such as 'Compared to the first round of negotiation, in the second negotiation, I felt more confident.'
